prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: []
1: ["Design Your Custom Desktop Companion", "Upload clear, well-lit photos for accurate 3D desktop pet rendering.", "Upload Photo"]
2: ["How to Interact with Your Pet", "Learn desktop hotkeys, summoning, hiding, and talking to your pet anytime.", "Got It!"]
3: ["Your Pet is Getting Ready!", "Play with desktop toys while your companion finishes waking up.", "Click toys to play while pet renders in the background"]
4: ["Choose Your Pet Journey"]
5: ["Back Up Your Pets to the Cloud", "Sign in to keep your pet data, custom looks, and memories safe on any computer.", "Pets created on guest accounts will not sync across re-installs or sign-ins."]
6: ["For best results, upload clear front-facing photos with bright lighting and simple backgrounds.", "Clear Front Lighting Recommended"]
7: ["If your pet doesn't appear on screen when finished, check system tray icons or multi-monitor settings."]
8: ["Welcome Your Companion to the Desktop!", "Swipe through quick tips to summon, chat with, or hide your pet anywhere on screen."]
9: ["Your Desktop Companion Awaits", "Meet an AI virtual pet that lives, plays, and keeps you company right on your computer screen."]
